ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 26 Nov 2026
points: Your site promotes 30% off sitewide, yet 0 of 15 ads mention an offer, so a buyer who clicks has no reason to act today. Put the 30% off in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site answers shipping in its FAQ, yet 0 of 18 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers must click away to learn it. Open new ads by answering shipping and name free shipping on orders $49+.
Your site shows prices from $29.99 to $44.99, yet 0 of 18 ads mention price, so a buyer cannot judge the cost before the click. Lead one ad with the price per bottle set against a daily coffee run.

Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 18 ads show how the bottle arrives, so a buyer cannot picture the delivery. Film the box arriving on a porch in one video and test it against your oldest ad.
